name: Ten'yoku no Asklein NIGHTMARE CURSE
original_name: 天翼のアスクレイン NIGHTMARE CURSE
source:
A nightmare that could have happened— a curse suddenly fell upon them.

Asklein Crysta and Sukuna no Himemiko continue their fight to protect people from the evil deeds of the Descending Demons.

One night, they come face to face with a demon wielding sorcery. The two manage to repel the demon, but the demon uses its "magic" as it dies.
The next thing the two realize, Crysta has been captured by researchers and is about to be used as an experimental subject, and Sukuna is about to be used as a plaything for the demons...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro-touch/work/=/product_id/VJ014533.html/]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
一场原本可能发生的噩梦——诅咒突然降临到了他们身上。

阿斯克林·克里斯塔和须久那姬美子继续为保护人们免受降魔的邪恶行为而战斗。

一天晚上，他们遇到了一个挥舞着魔法的恶魔。两人设法击退了恶魔，但恶魔在死亡时使用了它的“魔法”。
接下来两人意识到，克丽丝塔已经被研究人员捕获，即将被用作实验体，而须库那即将被用作恶魔的玩物……
